name: LUK-001 - Public Website Next.js Initialization
Description:
Initialize the public-facing marketing website using Next.js App Router and Tailwind CSS. Expectation: A fast, SEO-optimized static site base.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Next.js project initialized separately from the Admin portal
- Tailwind CSS and global design tokens configured
- Setup basic routing for Home, About, Pricing, and Contact
- Lighthouse performance score > 90 for Desktop and Mobile

name: LUK-002 - Country-Specific Landing Page Templates
Description:
Build dynamic route templates for localized marketing funnels (e.g. `/ng`, `/ke`). Expectation: Landing pages adapt copy and images based on the URL region.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Next.js dynamic routing configured for `/[country]`
- Content components switch out hero text, testimonials, and trust badges based on country param
- Default fallback to `/global` if country code is missing or unrecognized
- Static Site Generation (SSG) utilized for fast loading times

name: LUK-003 - Localized Pricing Tables UI
Description:
Build the pricing tier UI that dynamically reflects local currency (Volume 8). Expectation: Nigerian users see NGN, Kenyan users see KES, ROW sees USD.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Fetches geo-location from Kay's API or Cloudflare headers
- Pricing toggle (Monthly vs Annual)
- Displays correct currency symbol and localized price points
- Clear Call-to-Action (CTA) buttons linking to the signup/checkout flow

name: LUK-004 - Marketing Funnel Tracking & Analytics
Description:
Integrate Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, and PostHog for funnel tracking (Volume 2). Expectation: Marketing can track CAC from ad click to signup.

Acceptance Criteria:
- GTM data layer pushes events for 'Landing Page View', 'Signup Started'
- PostHog integration capturing anonymous user journeys
- Privacy-compliant cookie consent banner implemented
- Clean UTM parameter extraction and storage in browser session state

name: LUK-005 - Event & Webinar Catalog Page
Description:
Build the public storefront UI where users can browse upcoming paid webinars and past replays. Expectation: A clean, searchable grid of events.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Grid layout displaying Event Cards (Thumbnail, Title, Date, Host, Price)
- Search bar and category filters (e.g. 'Tech', 'Faith', 'Education')
- Pagination or infinite scroll for large catalogs
- Clicking a card navigates to the detailed Event page

name: LUK-006 - Detailed Event / Ticket Page
Description:
Build the specific page for a single event, showing details and the 'Buy Ticket' button. Expectation: High-converting event detail page.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Hero section with event banner, countdown timer, and Host bio
- Rich text description of what the webinar covers
- 'Buy Ticket' sticky footer on mobile
- Price displayed in local currency based on user geo

name: LUK-007 - Paystack / Flutterwave Checkout Drop-in
Description:
Integrate the frontend checkout modal for African payments (Paystack/Flutterwave). Expectation: Seamless UI payment flow.

Acceptance Criteria:
- UI calls Kay's backend API to initialize the transaction and receive an access code
- Loads the Paystack/Flutterwave inline checkout iframe or popup
- Handles frontend success callback by displaying a 'Processing...' loading state while polling backend for final verification
- Handles user cancellation or payment failure gracefully

name: LUK-008 - Stripe Checkout Integration UI
Description:
Integrate the frontend flow for Stripe payments (Rest of World). Expectation: Smooth redirect or embedded Stripe Elements flow.

Acceptance Criteria:
- UI calls Kay's backend to generate a Stripe Checkout Session ID
- Redirects user to Stripe hosted checkout page OR uses Stripe Elements inline
- Handles successful redirect back to the Konn3ct 'Success' page
- Displays 'Verifying Payment' loading state until backend confirms

name: LUK-009 - Post-Purchase Success & Digital Ticket UI
Description:
Build the success page displayed after a verified purchase. Expectation: User feels reassured and receives their access links.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Confetti animation and 'Payment Successful' confirmation
- Displays the generated Digital Ticket with QR Code (fetched from backend)
- Clear 'Add to Calendar' buttons (Google, Outlook, iCal)
- 'Go to Room' button that activates when the event starts
